product: JAR workloads in clean rooms are now generally available
tagline: You can now run compiled Java or Scala code in clean rooms.
what_it_does: You can now run compiled Java or Scala code in clean rooms. Run a JAR as its own clean room analysis, or register a function from a JAR and call it from a clean room notebook as a temporary UDF. This page describes how to run custom JAR workloads in a clean room.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: You can now run compiled Java or Scala code in clean rooms. Run a JAR as its own clean room analysis, or register a function from a JAR and call it from a clean room notebook as a temporary UDF.
key_takeaway: You can now run compiled Java or Scala code in clean rooms.
